description: Run all test files in a directory (optionally filtered) using testthat::test_dir(). Returns a summary of pass/fail/skip counts.

filter.description: Regex pattern to restrict which test files are run (e.g. 'my_func').

path.description: Absolute path to the directory containing test files.

reporter.description: testthat reporter to use (e.g. 'progress', 'summary', 'tap'). Defaults to 'progress'.

stop_on_failure.description: Whether to stop immediately on the first test failure (default false).

name: test_dir
